sanskrit: ni te padaṃ pade mama ni cittam etu niṣkṛtaḥ | yathāsaḥ kevalo mama- -ahaṃ sādhāraṇī tava ||
english: Let your footstep be set within my footstep; let your thought come to rest, bound fast. May you be wholly mine — I am held in common with you.

sanskrit: padena gām anu yanti padenāśvaṃ padā ratham | padena maryā mat tvaṃ na eṣo no ahaṃ tvat ||
english: By the footstep they track the cow; by the footstep the horse, by the footstep the chariot. By the footstep, O young man, you shall not go away from me, nor I from you.

sanskrit: māpa sṛpo mā parā sṛpo mānyatrāsman manas kṛthāḥ | yaṃ tvāhir iva bhogair nākulena parīmasi ||
english: Do not slip away, do not escape, do not set your mind elsewhere than upon us — you whom we encircle with coils as a serpent, with a mongoose.

sanskrit: ni tvā kṛṇve saṃnahane ni kurīre ny opaśe | ni tvādhamasmiṃl lomni ny u tvā muṣkayor mṛje ||
english: I bind you down in the binding-cord, I bind you in the head-ornament, I bind you in the tress of hair. I press you down here into this body-hair; I also rub you into the testicles.

sanskrit: ghṛtāhutā pṛthivī mā na eno 'smān prajāṃ vocata kilbiṣāṇi | anāturāḥ sumanasaḥ suvīrā jyog jīvantas tava sakhye syāma ||
english: O Earth, fed with ghee — let sins not be proclaimed against us, nor trespasses against our offspring. Free from affliction, of wholesome mind, with good heroes, may we live long in your friendship.

sanskrit: antar emi yātudhānān antar emi kimīdinaḥ | dhiyāma pitryā vayaṃ sarasvatyā carāmasi ||
english: I walk in among the sorcerers; I walk in among the malevolent ones. We fix our thought on the ancestral way; we move along with Sarasvatī.

sanskrit: mā te riṣaṃ khanitā yasmai ca tvā khanāmasi | dvipāc catuṣpād asmākaṃ mā riṣad devy oṣadhe ||
english: Let not the digger be harmed, nor him for whom we dig you up. Let neither the two-footed nor the four-footed among ours be harmed, O divine herb.

sanskrit: anyā vo anyām avatv anyānyasyā upāvata | sadhrīcīḥ savratā bhūtvā asyāvata vīryam ||
english: Let one of you help the other; let each give protection to the other. Having become harmonious and sharing the same vow, protect the vital power of this one.

sanskrit: dhruvas tiṣṭha bhuvanasya gopa mā saṃ vikthā vanaspate | atraiva tvam iha vayaṃ suvīrā viśvā mṛdho abhimātīr vy asya ||
english: Stand firm, O guardian of the world; do not shatter, O lord of the forest. Right here may you and we, possessed of good heroes, drive away all hostilities and attacks.

sanskrit: yo vānaspatyānām adhipatir babhūva yasminn imā viśvā bhuvanāny ārpitā | tam anajmi madhunā daivyena tasmān maṇiṃ nir mame viśvarūpam ||
english: He who became lord over the lords of the forest, in whom all these worlds are fixed — him I anoint with divine honey; from him I have fashioned this amulet of all-forms.

sanskrit: imaṃ maṇiṃ viśvajitaṃ suvīram asmād aśvatthāt pary ud bharāmi | yena viśvāḥ pṛtanāḥ saṃjayāny atho dyumat samitim ā vadāni ||
english: This amulet, all-conquering, endowed with good heroes — I lift it out entirely from this aśvattha tree, whereby I shall win all battles and speak brilliantly in the assembly.

sanskrit: sabandhuś cāsabandhuś ca yo na indrābhidāsati | vṛścāmi tasyāhaṃ mūlaṃ prajāṃ cakṣur atho balam ||
english: Whether kinsman or no kinsman — whoever assails us against Indra's will, I cut off his root, his offspring, his eye, and his strength.
